title: What to Do When Your Reflection Arrives First
hook_options: Your reflection should not be waiting for you.
If the mirror is early, you are already late.
Please allow your reflection to clear customs after you.
selected_hook: Your reflection should not be waiting for you.
traveler_promise: The Bureau's four-step courtesy interval can preserve your status as the original traveler.
setup: At the Liminal Arrivals Annex, reflected time may cross inspection several minutes ahead of the body.
impossible_rule: A reflection that moves first has borrowed your next decision and may file it as proof of identity precedence.
instructions: Do not greet the waiting reflection.
Step sideways until neither eye remains inside the silvered viewing cone.
Count three blinks the reflection cannot anticipate.
Present Form R-9 edge-first without touching the glass.
escalation: If the reflection sits down while you remain standing, it has begun the original-return claim.
institutional_contradiction: The Bureau calls this a courtesy interval; travelers who skip it are retained as decorative optics.
reveal: The contained reflection still wears a Bureau badge dated twelve years before the Annex opened.
closing_line: Return brightly, and whenever practical, return original.
bureau_sign_off: A traveler-safety notice from The Interstitial Travel Bureau.

narration_segments.text: Your reflection should not be waiting for you.
At the Liminal Arrivals Annex, reflected time occasionally clears customs first.
An early gesture means it has borrowed your next decision.
First, do not greet it. Courtesy may be interpreted as surrender.
Step sideways until both eyes leave the silvered viewing cone.
Next, count three blinks it did not anticipate.
Present Form R-9 edge-first. Neither paper nor fingers should touch the glass.
If it sits while you stand, the original-return claim has begun.
Remain calm. Decorative-optics classification is usually avoidable.
Containment is complete when your footsteps and reflection agree.
Do note the badge date. Return brightly, and whenever practical, return original.
